Date: Sat, 10 Jan 2027 09:15:00 -0800
Subject: Vendor inventory + upcoming cloud provider change

Hi Chloe,

As part of our procurement and vendor risk assessment for the upcoming Redwood contract renewal, we need an updated vendor inventory and a short declaration about any planned changes to your cloud/subprocessor footprint over the next 90 days. In particular:

- A CSV list of all subprocessors (vendor name, purpose, processing location, data types)
- Any planned migrations, new vendors, or deprecations that could affect BigBank data residency or continuity
- SOC2/ISO attestations for newly-introduced vendors (if applicable)

We are also attaching a short RFI that our security team uses for supply-chain changes. Could you return this by COB Wednesday 13 Jan? If there is any part of this request that will require internal review time (legal, procurement), call that out and provide an estimate.

Thanks,
Rajiv Patel
Vendor Risk Manager, BigBank
security@bigbank.com

Date: Mon, 11 Jan 2027 08:32:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Vendor inventory + upcoming cloud provider change

Rajiv / Sabrina,

Thanks for the note — we can provide the requested materials. Quick summary up front:

- Attached: the vendor inventory CSV and a short appendix (cloud mapping) that calls out an upcoming change affecting one non-critical edge provider (CloudEdge) used for regional peering in APAC; no BigBank production data is stored there.
- Planned change: CloudEdge will retire an older POP in APAC on 2027-02-20 and route traffic to a newer POP operated by the same vendor. We have validated HSM/KMS boundaries and there is no change to our primary data plane (hosted in AWS us-west-2 and GCP us-central1).
- Compliance: CloudEdge has provided SOC2 Type II and encryption attestations; copies are referenced in the appendix.

We are including our standard RFI responses as an appendix. Legal is on standby to review any redlines but we don't anticipate contractual changes for this migration. If you need a deeper architecture walkthrough, we can schedule a 30-min technical call this week.

Please find: 20270114-redwood-vendor-inventory.csv, 20270114-cloud-mapping-appendix.pdf, and 20270112-rfi-answers-appendix.docx attached.

Action items:
- Rajiv / Sabrina: confirm if BigBank requires signed attestations or copies of CloudEdge SOC2 before the 13 Jan deadline.
- Internal: Karthik / Lauren / Neha — see notes below, please confirm the compliance snippets and the timeline.

Best,
Chloe Martin

Date: Tue, 12 Jan 2027 10:47:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Vendor inventory + upcoming cloud provider change

Chloe / team — quick confirmation from infra:

- CloudEdge migration is limited to edge POP routing in APAC and will not change where BigBank customer data at rest resides. Primary storage remains in our AWS/GCP regions (aws-us-west-2 / gcp-us-central1).
- We validated that KV cache replication is regional-only and no cross-region artifacts will be introduced by the new POP.
- We have a fallback policy: if CloudEdge deprecates the POP earlier than expected, traffic will be routed through our CDN partner (FastPillar) for a short window; request routing will not lead to data residency change.

I attached a short snippet for the RFI that answers the continuity and fallback questions (see 20270112-rfi-answers-appendix.docx).

Lauren / Neha: please confirm whether procurement wants to notify customers via the Console banner or if we should include this in a broader vendor-change bulletin.

—Karthik
Director, Infrastructure Services

Subject: Re: Vendor inventory + upcoming cloud provider change

Rajiv / Sabrina — thanks for your patience while we pulled the materials together. Attached are the consolidated files and our RFI appendix. Highlights:

- Vendor inventory CSV includes required columns (vendor, use-case, processing location, data categories, SOC2/ISO link).
- The CloudEdge change is a non-production APAC edge POP retirement with migration to a same-vendor POP (no provider replacement). We do not expect any impact to BigBank data residency, encryption, or audit log continuity.
- We included copies of CloudEdge SOC2 Type II and the vendor statement confirming encryption-at-rest for edge caches.
- Timeline: scheduled cutover 2027-02-20; monitoring window through 2027-03-05.

If BigBank requires signed attestations (wet signature) for any of the vendor docs, please advise and we'll route to Legal / CloudEdge for execution. Otherwise, the Drive link contains scanned attestations and the CSV for ingestion into your vendor risk tooling.

Next steps:
- If you'd like a technical call, propose 30 minutes on Mon 18 Jan or Tue 19 Jan (PST).
- We will publish a public-facing vendor-change bulletin and a Console banner only if you request us to include BigBank-specific notification language.

Thanks — looking forward to your confirmation.
